title: The Impact of a Self-help Coping App on Distress Levels in Men Experiencing Infertility
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if the use of a new app, FertiStrong, is associated with decreased levels of anxiety and depression in men who have infertility or whose partner has infertility.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All men who are receiving care, or whose partner is receiving care, at Fertility Centers of Illinois during the study period.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Does not have daily access to a smart phone
2. Does not read or understand English
